Definition: properly, to address in a loud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to soothe, still, stroke; 1a) (Piel) to soothe, still; 1b) (Hiphil) stilling (participle); 2) to laud, praise, commend; 2a) (Piel); 2a1) to laud, praise (God); 2a2) to commend, congratulate (the dead); 2b) (Hithpael) to boast
